blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.why: «НЕГДЕ, НЕКУДА, НЕОТКУДА, НЕКОГДА: used with the Infinitive of the verb (without НЕ) in impersonal constructions. нигде, никуда, ниоткуда, никогда: used with any negative (НЕ) form of the verb.» — DLI, Lesson 105. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

«The direct object of a verb with negation (with не) is often in the genitive case instead of the accusative.» «To say 'There isn't …' we use the word нет followed by the genitive case.» — DLI, Lesson 27; Wikibooks.

«НЕКОГО, НЕЧЕГО … are used in impersonal constructions with the infinitive of the verb (without НЕ); никого, ничего … with any negative (НЕ) form of the verb.» — DLI, Lessons 104–105. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
